bio.text: Jon Husted has served in the U.S. Senate from Ohio since January 2025.

Before the Senate he was a member of the Ohio House of Representatives from 2000 and its Speaker from 2005 to 2009, then served in the Ohio State Senate, as Ohio secretary of state from 2011, and as lieutenant governor.
He earned bachelor's and master's degrees from the University of Dayton, was raised in Williams County, Ohio, and lives in Columbus.
